text:
Ada Park: quick request 1Need a small launch asset pack for the webinar: 1) single-page one-pager (US Letter PDF) with a compact benchmark sparkline + tiny 3-step inbound routing diagram, 2) two social headers (1200x628 data-forward, 800x800 exec-friendly), 3) hero image (1600x900) for the landing page. Brand-safe palette only. Deadline: Mon EOD PST.
Maria Chen: on it. For the one-pager, do you want dual-axis overlay for latency vs cost or two small sparklines?
Ada Park: try overlay first (dual y). If it gets noisy, fall back to side-by-side sparklines. Include a small table of top-3 recommended models and per-1k token costs.
Kevin Ortiz: sample series to use for the sparkline: latency_ms=[44,51,59,68,77] and cost_per_1k=[0.36,0.29,0.21,0.15,0.09]. Alt text: "Sparkline showing latency rising from 44ms to 77ms while cost per 1k tokens falls from $0.36 to $0.09 across model variants." (<=250 chars)
Maria Chen: noted. Filenames for handoff: wm24_launch_onepager_v1.pdf, wm24_social_data_1200x628.png, wm24_social_exec_800x800.png, wm24_hero_1600x900.jpg. I'll drop Figma files in /brand/marketing/wm24/launch-pack.
brand-bot: Brand checklist reminder Use palette: REDWOOD-500 #B91C1C + neutrals only. Typefaces: Inter (body), GT Aligned (headings). Max 2 typefaces. Text contrast >= 4.5:1. Export PNG/JPG @2x and include SVG for diagrams. See https://brand/redwood-guidelines (internal).
Ada Park: include footer copy: "\u00A9 Redwood Inference 2026  Internal benchmark summary - do not republish." Also add small attribution line: "Model data representative; not for external redistribution."
Jordan Li: ops note: registration form must include hidden fields: campaign=wm24_launch, source=webinar, lead_tag=bench_launch. When lead_score>=70 -> owner_pool=bench_sales. Sales also wants default lead_priority=medium for registrants. I'll share the mapping sheet with Ops after assets are live.
Maria Chen: accessibility: will provide tagged PDF, alt text, and longer description in metadata. I'll prototype overlay + split sparkline variants and share comps tomorrow morning.
Ada Park: perfect  please @me when comps are ready. Tiny 3-step diagram should be mono-line icons labeled: Register -> Ops qualify -> Book demo. Keep it compact; SVG preferred. Thanks!
